newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed, gas oil advances.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed, gas oil advances.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Friday, with gas oil firmer and gasoline flat, traders said.
Naphtha moved sideways, drifting, traders said. December swaps stayed between $223 and $224.75 cif NWE.
Gasoline prices were flat and the market was listless
High sulphur fuel gained $2 to $120-122 fob ARA with problems with prompt barrels the main driver. Bunker demand was muted.
Gas oil gained around $2.75 a tonne on futures. Low sulphur diesel premiums rose $3 with the apparent end of the French truckers' strike while those for heating oil advanced by $1.
